prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right agency depends on what you need (SEO, PPC, social, branding, B2B vs B2C), your budget, industry, and company size. I can recommend agencies, but first I need a few details so I can pick the best fit.

Quick questions:
- What type(s) of marketing do you need (SEO, paid ads, content/inbound, social, branding, email, performance analytics, etc.)?
- Are you B2B or B2C?
- What’s your monthly/annual marketing budget or preferred engagement size (freelancer/monthly retainer/agency project)?
- Do you prefer a local Maryland agency (in-person) or is remote ok?
- Any target industries or company size (startup, SMB, enterprise)?

If you want a quick starter: two well-known Maryland-based firms to consider are Blue Corona (Gaithersburg — strong on data-driven digital marketing and analytics) and Evenbound (Baltimore — inbound/B2B-focused). I can create a tailored shortlist of 3–5 agencies with reasons, pricing ranges, and next steps once you answer the questions above.

Also: if you want to evaluate agencies yourself, I can send a short checklist of what to look for (case studies, KPIs, reporting cadence, team, references, contract terms). Which would you prefer?
